top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes one transferable molecular principle, small-molecule-induced proximity between a chosen protein and a ubiquitin ligase that turns occupancy-driven inhibition into catalytic, event-driven removal. It is supported by ternary-complex structures, quantitative kinetics, independent reproduction and cereblon-directed agents already in patients, and the three-laureate allocation (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) covers both the PROTAC and molecular-glue entry points. P002 follows as the most mature and clearly chemical alternative, though attribution (Rothberg, Ju, Mayer) is weaker; P003 adds a younger, contested base-editing part; P004 is physical-chemistry principled but the in vivo state of condensates is still unsettled; no award ranks last.
